purpose: Pre-outcome identity and validation for Binance USD-M funding settlements used by the corrected TSMOM study.

source_window.included_partitions: 2021-2025 all months and 2026 months 1-7 only; no August 2026 or later data.

source_closure_method: sha256sum each selected monthly data.parquet in shell pathname-expansion order, including path names in each line, then sha256sum the resulting stream.
processing: Preserved the timestamp, symbol, funding interval, funding rate, and mark price from the canonical partitions without interpolation or value changes. Sorted by timestamp.
funding_formula: For signed base quantity q (positive long, negative short), funding cash flow = -q * mark_price * funding_rate. Positive funding rates debit longs and credit shorts; negative rates reverse that direction. No separate funding fee is applied.
timing_limitation: Binance states that actual funding fee transaction time can deviate by up to 15 seconds. The study uses hourly fills and cannot resolve that intra-minute ordering. The frozen study defines a deterministic bar-boundary convention and reports this limitation.
